name: audio2score
description: Audio → stems, MIDI y partituras multi-instrumento (rock y orquesta)

scripts.deploy-web:dev: npm run web:build-aws && cd serverless/web && sls deploy
scripts.deploy-web:test: npm run web:build-aws && cd serverless/web && sls deploy --stage test
scripts.deploy-web:prod: npm run web:build-aws && cd serverless/web && sls deploy --stage prod
scripts.web:build-aws: VITE_API_URL=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /audio2score-api/ApiUrl --query Parameter.Value --output text) npm --prefix web run build
scripts.worker:status: aws sagemaker describe-endpoint --endpoint-name audio2score-worker --query '{status: EndpointStatus, instances: ProductionVariants[0].CurrentInstanceCount}'
scripts.format: prettier --write . && yapf -i -r src tests && python3 -m isort src tests && npm --prefix web run format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && yapf --diff -r src tests && python3 -m isort --check-only src tests && npm --prefix web run format:check
scripts.lint: pylint src tests && eslint container && npm --prefix web run lint

author: Sebastian Torres
